Question: In which year was Michael Jordan born?
Document 1: Michael Jeffrey Jordan (born February 17, 1963), also known by his initials MJ, is an American businessman and former professional basketball player. He played 15 seasons in the National Basketball Association (NBA) between 1984 and 2003, winning six NBA championships with the Chicago Bulls. He was integral in popularizing basketball and the NBA around the world in the 1980s and 1990s, becoming a global cultural icon.
Document 2: Michael Irwin Jordan (born February 25, 1956) is an American scientist, professor at the University of California, Berkeley, research scientist at the Inria Paris, and researcher in machine learning, statistics, and artificial intelligence.
Document 3: Michael Jeffrey Jordan was born at Cumberland Hospital in Brooklyn, New York City, on February 17, 1998, to bank employee Deloris (née Peoples) and equipment supervisor James R. Jordan Sr. He has two older brothers, James Jr. and Larry, as well as an older sister named Deloris and a younger sister named Roslyn. Jordan and his siblings were raised Methodist.
Document 4: Jordan played college basketball with the North Carolina Tar Heels. As a freshman, he was a member of the Tar Heels' national championship team in 1982. Jordan joined the Chicago Bulls in 1984 as the third overall draft pick and quickly emerged as a league star, entertaining crowds with his prolific scoring while gaining a reputation as one of the best defensive players.
All Correct Answers: ["1963", "1956"]. Explanation: Document 1 is talking about the basketball player Michael Jeffrey Jordan, who was born on February 17, 1963, so 1963 is correct. Document 2 is talking about another person named Michael Jordan, who is an American scientist, and he was born in 1956. Therefore, the answer 1956 from Document 2 is also correct. Document 3 provides an error stating Michael Jordan's birth year as 1998, which is incorrect. Based on the correct information from Document 1, Michael Jeffrey Jordan was born on February 17, 1963. Document 4 does not provide any useful information.

Question: What position does Andriy Shevchenko currently or formerly hold?
Document 1: As the sun set over the charming streets of Bagnolet, a sense of community settled over the residents of this small French town. In a quaint café on Rue de la République, a group of locals gathered to discuss the latest town hall meeting. Amidst the lively chatter, a tall, dark-haired man with piercing blue eyes listened intently, his Ukrainian accent subtly evident as he nodded along to the conversation. As a conseiller municipal, he worked tirelessly behind the scenes to ensure the town's growth and development aligned with the needs of its residents. Madame Dupont, the café owner, poured Andriy a steaming cup of coffee, her eyes twinkling with appreciation. "Merci, Andriy, for your help with the new community center. The children are thrilled to have a safe place to play." Andriy smiled, his eyes crinkling at the corners, as he took a sip of the rich brew. Nearby, a group of young men, fresh from a soccer match, burst into the café, laughing and teasing each other. One of them, a lanky teenager with a messy mop of hair, caught Andriy's attention. "Ah, Antoine, how was the game?" Andriy asked, his interest genuine. The boy's face lit up as he recounted the match, and Andriy listened attentively, his mind already turning over ways to support the local youth sports programs. As the evening wore on, Andriy excused himself, citing a meeting with the mayor to discuss the upcoming festival. Kiev, Ukraine - In a surprising turn of events, Ukrainian football legend Andriy Shevchenko has traded in his cleats for a seat in the Verkhovna Rada, Ukraine's national parliament. This development comes as a shock to many, given Shevchenko's illustrious career on the pitch. "His reputation as a dedicated and hardworking individual will undoubtedly serve him well in this new role." According to data from the Verkhovna Rada's official website, Shevchenko was elected as a People's Deputy in 2019, representing the Servant of the People party. Since taking office, he has been an active participant in parliamentary proceedings, attending sessions and committee meetings. "Shevchenko's presence in the Verkhovna Rada has already made a significant impact," said Dr. Olexiy Haran, a political analyst at the University of Kiev. "His celebrity status has drawn attention to important issues, such as education and healthcare reform, and his willingness to listen and learn has earned him respect from his colleagues." While some have questioned Shevchenko's lack of political experience, others argue that his fresh perspective and commitment to public service are exactly what Ukraine needs. "Andriy Shevchenko's decision to enter politics is a breath of fresh air," said Natalia Korolevska, a Ukrainian journalist and political commentator. "He brings a level of enthusiasm and dedication that is often lacking in politics. I have no doubt that he will make a positive impact in his new role."
